title: TADDLE: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Detecting Deficient LLM-Generated Peer Reviews
abstract: arXiv:2605.26911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-generated peer reviews are increasingly common at major venues, yet their deficiencies are hard to detect because they are uniformly fluent and well-structured. Existing work either classifies authorship without judging quality, or scores quality with features designed for human-written reviews; no prior system detects deficiencies in LLM-generated reviews at the level of individual defect types. To bridge the gap, we introduce TADDLE, a Tool-Augmented Agent for Detecting Deficient LLM-Generated Peer Reviews, together with the first expert-annotated benchmark for this task. Our benchmark comprises 1,800 reviews on 50 ICLR 2025 papers, multi-label-annotated by 18 domain experts against a taxonomy of six defect categories (plus a non-deficient label). translated_title: TADDLE：一种用于检测有缺陷的LLM生成同行评审的工具增强型智能体
translated_abstract: LLM生成的同行评审在主要学术会议上越来越常见，然而由于其表达 uniformly 流畅且结构良好，其缺陷难以被检测。现有工作要么仅对作者身份进行分类而不评判质量，要么使用为人类撰写评审设计的特征来评分质量；此前没有任何系统能够在单个缺陷类型的层面检测LLM生成评审中的缺陷。为填补这一空白，我们提出了TADDLE，一个用于检测有缺陷的LLM生成同行评审的工具增强型智能体，并为此任务构建了首个专家标注的基准数据集。该基准包含针对50篇ICLR 2025论文的1800份评审，由18位领域专家根据六种缺陷类别（外加一个无缺陷标签）的分类体系进行多标签标注。TADDLE将检测任务分解为四个专门的分析工具——验证、纠错、补全和转换——由一个智能体进行编排调度；一个整合器将它们的输出合成为……
tldr: 提出TADDLE，首个能在具体缺陷类型层面检测LLM生成同行评审缺陷的工具增强型智能体系统，并发布了首个由专家多标签标注的该任务基准数据集。
en_tdlr: TADDLE, a tool-augmented agent that detects deficiencies in LLM-generated peer reviews at the individual defect-type level via four specialized analysis tools, together with the first expert-annotated benchmark for this task.
